rows.text_en: Ministry of Health and Welfare ( Disability Services Division ), 044-202-3345

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「장애인활동 지원에 관한 법률」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on Support for Activities of Persons with Disabilities and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(활동지원급여의 신청) 「장애인활동 지원에 관한 법률」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제6조에 따라 활동지원급여를 신청하려는 사람은 활동지원급여 신청서에 제41조에 따라 본인부담금을 환급받을 계좌가 표시된 통장 사본을 첨부하여 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장(자치구의 구청장을 말한다. 이하 같다)에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30., 2018. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Application for Activity Support Benefits) A person who intends to apply for activity support benefits pursuant to Article 6 of the Act on Support for Activities of Persons with Disabilities (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”)benefits to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head (referring to the head of an autonomous district; hereinafter the same applies), attaching a copy of a bank passbook indicating the account for receiving the refund of the co-payment pursuant to Article 41. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016; Dec. 31, 2018>
1. Deleted <December 31, 2018>
2. Deleted <December 31, 2018>
Article 3 Deleted <December 31, 2018>
Article 4 Deleted <December 31, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 제5조(활동지원수급자격결정통지 사항) 법 제11조제1항제6호에서 “보건복지부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 다음 각 호의 사항을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Matters for Notification of Decision on Eligibility for Activity Support) The term “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Health and Welfare” in Article 11, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 6 of the Act refers to the following matters:

rows.source_ko: 1. 활동지원급여 수급자격(이하 “수급자격”이라 한다) 결정의 유효기간
rows.text_en: 1. Validity period of the determination of eligibility for activity support benefits (hereinafter referred to as “eligibility”)

rows.source_ko: 2. 활동지원급여의 월 한도액
rows.text_en: 2. Monthly limit for activity support benefits

rows.source_ko: 3. 본인부담금을 납부할 계좌
rows.text_en: 3. Account for paying the co-payment

rows.source_ko: 4. 수급자로 인정되지 못한 경우 그 사유
rows.text_en: 4. Reasons for not being recognized as a beneficiary

rows.source_ko: 5. 그 밖에 법 제8조제1항에 따른 장애인활동지원 수급자격심의위원회의 심의 의견
rows.text_en: 5. Other opinions of the Committee for the Review of Eligibility for Activity Support for Persons with Disabilities pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 제6조(표준급여이용계획서) 법 제11조제2항에 따른 표준급여이용계획서는 별지 제1호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Standard Benefit Utilization Plan) The standard benefit utilization plan pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall be in the form of Annex No. 1 .

rows.source_ko: 제7조(수급자격 결정 유효기간의 산정 방법) 법 제12조에 따른 수급자격 결정 유효기간은 급여개시일이 속한 달의 다음 달 1일부터 계산한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Method of Calculating the Validity Period of Determination of Eligibility for Benefits) The validity period of the determination of eligibility for benefits pursuant to Article 12 of the Act shall be calculated from the 1st day of the month following the month in which the benefit commencement date falls.

rows.source_ko: 제8조(수급자격의 갱신 신청) ① 법 제13조제1항에 따라 수급자격 갱신을 신청하려는 수급자는 수급자격 결정의 유효기간이 끝나기 90일 전부터 30일 전까지의 기간에 활동지원수급자격 갱신신청서를 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Application for Renewal of Eligibility) ① A beneficiary who intends to apply for the renewal of eligibility pursuant to Article 13, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit an application for renewal of eligibility for activity support to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head during the period from 90 days to 30 days prior to the expiration of the validity period of the eligibility determination. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: ② 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 수급자격 결정의 유효기간이 끝나기 120일 전까지 수급자에게 갱신 신청의 기간, 절차 등 갱신에 필요한 사항과 해당 기간까지 신청하지 아니하면 갱신을 받을 수 없다는 사실을 안내하여야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head shall notify the beneficiary of matters necessary for renewal, such as the application period and procedures, and the fact that renewal cannot be granted if an application is not submitted by the said period, at least 120 days before the expiration of the validity period of the determination of eligibility. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제2항에 따른 안내는 휴대전화 문자메시지, 전자우편, 팩스, 전화, 문서 등의 방법으로 할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ③ The notice pursuant to Paragraph 2 may be provided by means such as mobile phone text messages, email, fax, telephone, or documents.

rows.source_ko: 제9조(활동지원등급의 변경 신청) 법 제14조제1항에 따라 활동지원등급의 변경을 신청하려는 수급자는 활동지원등급 변경신청서에 의사소견서 등 변경사항을 확인할 수 있는 서류 1부를 첨부하여 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Application for Change of Activity Support Grade) A beneficiary who intends to apply for a change of activity support grade pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit an application for change of activity support grade to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head, attaching one copy of documents verifying the changes, such as a medical opinion. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 제10조(신청 등에 대한 대리) 법 제15조에 따라 활동지원급여를 받으려는 사람 또는 수급자를 대리하여 활동지원급여 신청, 수급자격의 갱신 신청 또는 활동지원등급의 변경 신청 등을 하려는 사람은 다음 각 호의 구분에 따라 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 신분증을 제시하거나 서류를 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Representation for Applications, etc.) A person who intends to receive activity support benefits pursuant to Article 15 of the Act , or a person who intends to apply for activity support benefits, apply for renewal of eligibility, or apply for a change in activity support grade, etc., on behalf of a beneficiary, shall present an identification card or submit documents to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head in accordance with the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 1. 법 제15조제1항에 따른 본인의 가족이나 친족, 그 밖의 관계인: 대리인의 신분증
rows.text_en: 1. Family members, relatives, or other related persons pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 1 of the Act : Representative's identification card

rows.source_ko: 2. 법 제15조제2항에 따른 사회복지전담공무원: 활동지원급여를 받으려는 사람 또는 수급자 본인이나 그 가족의 동의서 1부 및 사회복지전담공무원임을 확인할 수 있는 신분증
rows.text_en: 2. Social welfare officer pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 2 of the Act : One copy of the consent form from the person seeking activity support benefits or the recipient themselves or their family, and an identification card verifying status as a social welfare officer

rows.source_ko: 3. 법 제15조제3항에 따른 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장이 지정하는 사람: 별지 제2호서식의 대리인 지정서 1부
rows.text_en: 3. Person designated by the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, Mayor, County Head, or District Head pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 3 of the Act : One copy of the Designation of Agent Form ( Attached No. 2 )

rows.source_ko: 제11조(방문간호지시서) 법 제16조제1항제3호에 따른 방문간호지시서(이하 “방문간호지시서”라 한다)는 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Visiting Nursing Instruction) The visiting nursing instruction pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “visiting nursing instruction”) shall be in the form specified in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 의사 또는 한의사가 발급하는 경우: 별지 제3호서식
rows.text_en: 1. In cases where issued by a physician or a doctor of Korean medicine: Attached Form No. 3

rows.source_ko: 2. 치과의사가 발급하는 경우: 별지 제4호서식
rows.text_en: 2. When issued by a dentist: Attached Form No. 4

rows.source_ko: 제12조(활동지원급여의 제공 기준 및 범위) ① 법 제16조제2항제1호 및 제2호의 가족은 다음 각 호의 사람을 말한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Criteria and Scope of Provision of Activity Support Benefits) ① The family referred to in Article 16, Paragraph 2 , Subparagraphs 1 and 2 of the Act means persons falling under each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 1. 배우자, 직계혈족 및 형제자매
rows.text_en: 1. Spouse, lineal blood relatives, and siblings

rows.source_ko: 2. 직계혈족의 배우자
rows.text_en: 2. Spouse of a lineal blood relative

rows.source_ko: 3. 배우자의 직계혈족 및 배우자의 형제자매
rows.text_en: 3. Spouse's lineal relatives and spouse's siblings

rows.source_ko: ② 수급자는 두 종류 이상의 활동지원급여를 동일한 시간에 받을 수 없다. 다만, 방문간호는 응급 처치가 필요한 경우 등 부득이한 사유가 있는 경우에는 다른 종류의 활동지원급여와 동일한 시간에 받을 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② A beneficiary may not receive two or more types of activity support benefits at the same time. However, visiting nursing may be received at the same time as other types of activity support benefits in cases of unavoidable circumstances, such as when emergency treatment is required.

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제20조에 따른 장애인활동지원기관(이하 “활동지원기관”이라 한다)은 활동지원급여의 종류 및 내용에 대한 수급자의 선택권을 존중하고 수급자의 심신상태 등에 따라 적정하게 급여를 제공하여야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ③ An activity support agency for persons with disabilities pursuant to Article 20 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “activity support agency”) shall respect the recipient’s right to choose regarding the type and content of activity support benefits and provide benefits appropriately in accordance with the recipient’s mental and physical condition, etc. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 제13조(활동지원급여의 제공 절차 및 방법) ① 법 제16조제2항에 따라 수급자는 활동지원급여를 제공받으려면 활동지원기관에 법 제11조에 따른 활동지원수급자격결정통지서 및 표준급여이용계획서를 제시하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Procedure and Method of Providing Activity Support Benefits) ① In accordance with Article 16, Paragraph 2 of the Act , if a recipient wishes to receive activity support benefits, they must present the notice of determination of eligibility for activity support benefits pursuant to Article 11 of the Act and the standard benefit utilization plan to the activity support agency.

rows.source_ko: ② 활동지원기관은 수급자에게 활동지원급여를 제공하려면 제1항의 서류를 통하여 다음 각 호의 사항을 확인하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② In order to provide activity support benefits to a beneficiary, an activity support agency must verify the matters in each of the following subparagraphs through the documents referred to in Paragraph 1.

rows.source_ko: 1. 수급자 본인 여부
rows.text_en: 1. Verification of the recipient's identity

rows.source_ko: 2. 수급자격
rows.text_en: 2. Eligibility

rows.source_ko: 3. 활동지원등급
rows.text_en: 3. Activity Support Grade

rows.source_ko: 4. 수급자격 결정의 유효기간
rows.text_en: 4. Validity period of eligibility determination

rows.source_ko: 5. 활동지원급여의 월 한도액
rows.text_en: 5. Monthly limit for activity support benefits

rows.source_ko: 6. 표준급여이용계획서에 따른 활동지원급여의 이용 방법
rows.text_en: 6. Method of utilizing activity support benefits according to the Standard Benefit Utilization Plan

rows.source_ko: ③ 활동지원기관은 수급자가 제1항의 서류를 제시하지 못하는 경우에는 특별자치시ㆍ특별자치도ㆍ시ㆍ군ㆍ구(자치구를 말한다. 이하 같다) 또는 「국민연금법」 제24조에 따른 국민연금공단(이하 “공단”이라 한다)에 전화 등을 통하여 제2항 각 호의 사항을 확인할 수 있다. <개정 2016. 12. 30., 2018. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ③ If a beneficiary is unable to present the documents referred to in Paragraph 1, the activity support agency may verify the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Paragraph 2 via telephone, etc., with a Special Self-Governing City, Special Self-Governing Province, City, County, or District (referring to an autonomous district; hereinafter the same applies) or the National Pension Service pursuant to Article 24 of the National Pension Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Service”). <Amended Dec. 30, 2016; Dec. 31, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ④ 활동지원기관은 활동지원급여를 제공하기 전에 수급자와 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함된 활동지원급여 제공 계약을 체결하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ Before providing activity support benefits, the activity support agency must enter into an activity support benefit provision contract with the recipient that includes the following items.

rows.source_ko: 1. 계약 당사자
rows.text_en: 1. Contracting Parties

rows.source_ko: 2. 계약 기간
rows.text_en: 2. Contract Period

rows.source_ko: 3. 활동지원급여의 종류, 내용 및 비용
rows.text_en: 3. Types, Contents, and Costs of Activity Support Benefits

rows.source_ko: 4. 비급여 대상 서비스의 내용 및 비용
rows.text_en: 4. Content and Cost of Non-Covered Services

rows.source_ko: 5. 손해배상책임 등
rows.text_en: 5. Liability for damages, etc.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 활동지원기관은 제4항에 따른 계약을 체결하거나 변경하면 계약서를 2부 작성하여 1부는 보관하고, 1부는 지체 없이 수급자에게 발급하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ When an activity support agency enters into or amends a contract pursuant to Paragraph 4, it shall prepare two copies of the contract, keep one copy, and issue the other copy to the recipient without delay.

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 활동지원기관은 제4항에 따른 계약을 체결하거나 변경하면 지체 없이 별지 제5호서식의 활동지원급여 제공계획서를 공단에 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ If an activity support agency enters into or changes a contract pursuant to Paragraph 4, it shall submit the activity support benefit provision plan in the form of Annex 5 to the Corporation without delay.

rows.source_ko: 제14조(활동지원급여이용권의 신청 등) ① 법 제17조제2항에 따라 활동지원급여이용권을 지급받으려는 수급자는 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 활동지원급여이용권 지급신청서를 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Application for Activity Support Benefit Voucher, etc.) ① A beneficiary who wishes to receive an Activity Support Benefit Voucher pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall submit an application for the provision of an Activity Support Benefit Voucher to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Governor, or a District Head. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에서 규정한 사항 외에 활동지원급여이용권의 신청, 지급, 이용 등에 필요한 사항은 보건복지부장관이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ② In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraph 1, matters necessary for the application, payment, use, etc. of activity support benefit vouchers shall be determined by the Minister of Health and Welfare .

rows.source_ko: 제15조(활동지원급여 월 한도액의 산정 방법) ① 법 제18조에 따른 활동지원급여의 월 한도액은 법 제7조제1항에 따라 실시한 「장애인복지법」 제32조의4에 따른 서비스 지원 종합조사(이하 “서비스 지원 종합조사”라 한다)의 결과에 따라 산정된 금액으로 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30., 2018. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Method of Calculating the Monthly Limit for Activity Support Benefits) ①The monthly limit for activity support benefits under Article 18 of the Act shall be the amount calculated based on the results of the comprehensive service support survey under Article 32-4 of the Welfare Act for Persons with Disabilities conducted pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Comprehensive Service Support Survey”). <Amended Dec. 30, 2016; Dec. 31, 2018>
1. Deleted <December 31, 2018>
2. Deleted <December 31, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제30조제3항 단서에 따라 수급자가 가족인 활동지원인력으로부터 활동지원급여를 받는 경우에는 제1항에 따른 월 한도액의 2분의 1의 범위에서 그 금액을 줄일 수 있다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② In cases where a beneficiary receives activity support benefits from an activity support worker who is a family member pursuant to the proviso to Article 30, Paragraph 3 of the Act , the amount may be reduced within the range of one-half of the monthly limit under Paragraph 1. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 및 제2항에 따른 월 한도액 중 그 달에 사용하지 않은 금액은 보건복지부장관이 정하는 범위에서 다음 달로 이월할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ③ Any amount of the monthly limit under Paragraphs 1 and 2 that is not used in that month may be carried over to the following month within the scope determined by the Minister of Health and Welfare .

rows.source_ko: ④ 제1항부터 제3항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 월 한도액의 산정, 이월 등에 필요한 사항은 보건복지부장관이 정하여 고시한다.
rows.text_en: ④ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 3, matters necessary for the calculation of the monthly limit, carryover, etc. shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Health and Welfare .

rows.source_ko: 제16조(활동지원급여의 중단 요건) 법 제19조제3항제3호에서 “보건복지부령으로 정하는 경우”란 다음 각 호의 경우를 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Conditions for Suspension of Activity Support Benefits) The phrase “cases prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Health and Welfare” in Article 19, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 3 of the Act refers to any of the following cases:

rows.source_ko: 1. 국외체류 기간이 60일 이상 지속되는 경우
rows.text_en: 1. Cases where the period of stay abroad lasts for 60 days or more

rows.source_ko: 2. 「의료법」 제3조에 따른 의료기관에 보건복지부장관이 정하는 기간 이상 지속하여 입원한 경우
rows.text_en: 2. Cases where a person is hospitalized continuously for a period longer than that prescribed by the Minister of Health and Welfare at a medical institution pursuant to Article 3 of the Medical Service Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 그 밖에 다른 법령에 따라 활동지원급여와 비슷한 급여를 받고 있다고 보건복지부장관이 인정하는 경우
rows.text_en: 3. Cases where the Minister of Health and Welfare recognizes that benefits similar to activity support benefits are being received pursuant to other laws and regulations

rows.source_ko: 제16조의2(활동지원급여의 중단 또는 제한) ① 법 제19조제1항에 따른 활동지원급여의 중단 또는 제한에 관하여는 별표 1에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 16-2 (Suspension or Restriction of Activity Support Benefits) ①The suspension or restriction of activity support benefits pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be in accordance with Annex 1 .

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에서 정한 사항 외에 활동지원급여의 중단 또는 제한에 관한 세부 절차와 방법은 보건복지부장관이 정하여 고시한다.
rows.text_en: ② In addition to the matters specified in Paragraph 1, detailed procedures and methods regarding the suspension or restriction of activity support benefits shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Health and Welfare .
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 30, 2016]

rows.source_ko: 제16조의3(활동지원 응급안전서비스 제공) ① 법 제19조의2제1항에 따른 활동지원 응급안전서비스(이하 “응급안전서비스”라 한다)를 제공받으려는 자 또는 그 대리인은 별지 제5호의2서식의 응급안전서비스 신청서를 작성하여 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2018. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 16-3 (Provision of Activity Support Emergency Safety Services) ①Any person who intends to receive activity support emergency safety services pursuant to Article 19-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “Emergency Safety Services”), or their representative, shall complete the application for Emergency Safety Services in accordance with Form No. 5-2 of the Appendix and submit it to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head. <Amended Dec. 31, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 응급안전서비스를 신청받은 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 신청받은 날부터 30일 이내에 응급안전서비스 대상자 선정 여부를 결정하여 통보해야 한다. 다만, 2019년 7월 1일부터 12월 31일까지 받은 응급안전서비스 신청에 대해서는 신청받은 날부터 60일 이내에 통보할 수 있다. <개정 2018. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ② The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head who receives an application for emergency safety services pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall determine whether to select a recipient for emergency safety services and notify them within 30 days from the date of receipt of the application. However, for applications for emergency safety services received from July 1, 2019, to December 31, 2019, notification may be made within 60 days from the date of receipt. <Amended Dec. 31, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 및 제2항에 따른 응급안전서비스 제공에 관한 신청 및 결정 절차 등은 보건복지부장관이 정하여 고시한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The application and decision procedures, etc. regarding the provision of emergency safety services pursuant to Paragraphs 1 and 2 shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Health and Welfare .
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 30, 2016]

rows.source_ko: 제17조(활동지원기관의 지정기준) 법 제20조제1항에서 “보건복지부령으로 정하는 시설 및 인력 기준”이란 별표 1의2와 같다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 17 (Criteria for Designation of Activity Support Agencies) The “facility and personnel standards prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Health and Welfare” in Article 20 , Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be as set forth in Annex 1-2 . <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 제18조(활동지원기관의 지정) ① 법 제20조제1항에 따라 활동지원기관으로 지정받으려는 자는 별지 제6호서식의 활동지원기관 지정신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 18 (Designation of Activity Support Agency) ①Any person who intends to be designated as an activity support agency pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit an application for designation as an activity support agency in the form of Annex 6, attached with the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 1. 정관 1부(법인만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 1. One copy of the Articles of Incorporation (applicable only to corporations)

rows.source_ko: 2. 사업계획서 및 운영규정을 적은 서류 각 1부
rows.text_en: 2. One copy each of the business plan and operating regulations

rows.source_ko: 3. 제17조에 따른 지정기준을 충족하였음을 확인할 수 있는 서류 1부
rows.text_en: 3. One copy of documents confirming that the designation criteria under Article 17 have been met

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 담당 공무원은 신청인이 법인인 경우 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서를 확인하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The public official in charge who receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall verify the certificate of corporate registration through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act if the applicant is a corporation.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 보건복지부장관이 정하는 세부사항을 고려하여 법 제20조제2항에 따라 적정 수의 활동기관을 지정하여야 한다. 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장이 활동지원기관을 지정하는 경우에는 별지 제7호서식의 활동지원기관 지정서를 발급하여야 하며, 지정을 거부하는 경우에는 그 사유를 밝혀 신청인에게 서면으로 알려야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head who receives an application under Paragraph 1 shall designate an appropriate number of activity agencies in accordance with Article 20, Paragraph 2 of the Act , taking into consideration the detailed matters prescribed by the Minister of Health and Welfare . When the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head designates an activity support agency, they shall issue a Certificate of Designation for an Activity Support Agency in the form of Annex 7 ; if they refuse the designation, they shall notify the applicant in writing, stating the reasons therefor. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: ④ 활동지원기관 지정의 기준 및 방법 등에 관하여 필요한 세부 사항은 보건복지부장관이 정하여 고시한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Minister of Health and Welfare shall determine and announce the necessary detailed matters regarding the standards and methods for designating activity support agencies .

rows.source_ko: 제19조(활동지원기관의 변경지정 사항) 법 제20조제4항 전단에서 “보건복지부령으로 정하는 중요 사항”이란 활동지원급여의 종류를 말한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 19 (Matters Regarding Change of Designation of Activity Support Agencies) In the first part of Article 20, Paragraph 4 of the Act , “important matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Health and Welfare” refers to the types of activity support benefits. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 1. 활동지원급여의 종류
rows.text_en: 1. Types of Activity Support Benefits

rows.source_ko: 제20조(활동지원기관의 변경지정) ① 법 제20조제4항 전단에 따라 변경지정을 받으려는 자는 별지 제8호서식의 활동지원기관 변경지정 신청서에 변경사항을 확인할 수 있는 서류 1부와 활동지원기관 지정서를 첨부하여 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 20 (Change of Designation of Activity Support Agency) ①person who intends to receive a change of designation pursuant to the first part of Article 20, Paragraph 4 of the Act shall submit an Application for Change of Designation of Activity Support Agency in the form of Annex 8 , attached with one copy of documents verifying the changes and the certificate of designation of the activity support agency, to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 변경사항을 확인하고 별지 제7호서식의 활동지원기관 지정서를 다시 발급하여야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Governor, or a District Head who receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall verify the changes and reissue the Certificate of Designation of Activity Support Agency in accordance with Form No. 7. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 제21조(활동지원기관의 변경사항 신고) 법 제20조제4항 후단에 따라 제19조에 따른 변경지정 사항 외의 변경사항을 신고하려는 자는 변경사항이 발생한 날부터 14일 이내에 별지 제9호서식의 활동지원기관 변경사항 신고서에 변경사항을 확인할 수 있는 서류 1부를 첨부하여 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 21 (Reporting of Changes to Activity Support Agencies) Any person who intends to report changes other than those designated under Article 19 pursuant to the latter part of Article 20 , Paragraph 4 of the Act shall submit a Report on Changes to Activity Support Agencies in the Form No. 9 attached hereto to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head within 14 days from the date the changes occurred, attaching one copy of documents verifying the changes. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 제22조(활동지원기관 정보의 안내) ① 법 제21조에 따라 활동지원기관은 공단에 다음 각 호의 자료를 제출하여야 한다. 해당 정보가 변경된 경우에도 또한 같다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 22 (Guidance on Information on Activity Support Agencies) ① Pursuant to Article 21 of the Act , activity support agencies shall submit the data set forth in each of the following subparagraphs to the Corporation. The same shall apply in cases where such information is changed. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 1. 기관명, 전화번호, 주소, 약도 및 홈페이지 주소
rows.text_en: 1. Organization name, phone number, address, map, and website address

rows.source_ko: 2. 시설ㆍ설비 현황과 그 사진
rows.text_en: 2. Status of Facilities and Equipment and Photos

rows.source_ko: 3. 인력 종류별 현황
rows.text_en: 3. Status by Personnel Type

rows.source_ko: 4. 제공하는 활동지원급여의 종류 및 내용
rows.text_en: 4. Types and Details of Activity Support Benefits Provided

rows.source_ko: 5. 활동지원급여 제공 계약 등 이용 방법에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the method of use, such as the activity support benefit provision contract

rows.source_ko: ② 공단은 제1항에 따라 제출받은 자료를 공단 홈페이지에 게시하여야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Corporation shall post the materials received pursuant to Paragraph 1 on the Corporation’s website. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: ③ 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 법 제11조제1항에 따라 수급자에게 활동지원수급자격결정통지서를 보낼 때에는 제2항에 따라 게시된 활동지원기관에 대한 정보를 안내하여야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ③ When the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head sends a notice of determination of eligibility for activity support to a recipient pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 1 of the Act , they shall provide information regarding the activity support agencies posted pursuant to Paragraph 2. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 제23조(활동지원급여비용 명세서) 법 제22조제3항에 따른 활동지원급여비용 명세서는 별지 제10호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 23 (Statement of Activity Support Benefit Costs) The statement of activity support benefit costs pursuant to Article 22, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall be in the form of Attached Form No. 10 .

rows.source_ko: 제24조(활동지원급여 제공 기록) 활동지원기관의 장은 활동지원급여를 제공하면 법 제22조제4항에 따라 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 서식에 해당 내용을 기록하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 24 (Record of Provision of Activity Support Benefits) When the head of an activity support agency provides activity support benefits, he/she shall record the relevant details in the form according to the classification in each of the following subparagraphs pursuant to Article 22, Paragraph 4 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: 1. 법 제16조제1항제1호에 따른 활동보조를 제공한 경우: 별지 제11호서식의 활동지원급여 제공기록지
rows.text_en: 1. In cases where activity assistance has been provided pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the Act : Activity Support Benefit Provision Record Form (Attached Form No. 11)

rows.source_ko: 2. 법 제16조제1항제2호에 따른 방문목욕을 제공한 경우: 별지 제12호서식의 활동지원급여 제공기록지
rows.text_en: 2. In cases where visiting bathing services were provided pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Act : Activity Support Benefit Provision Record Form (Attached) No. 12

rows.source_ko: 3. 법 제16조제1항제3호에 따른 방문간호를 제공한 경우: 별지 제13호서식의 활동지원급여 제공기록지
rows.text_en: 3. In cases where visiting nursing was provided pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3 of the Act : Activity Support Benefit Provision Record Form (Attached Form No. 13)

rows.source_ko: 제25조(활동지원급여 제공 기록의 보존) 활동지원기관의 장은 법 제22조제4항에 따라 다음 각 호의 자료를 기록이 끝난 날부터 5년 동안 보존해야 한다. <개정 2019. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 25 (Preservation of Records of Activity Support Benefit Provision) The head of an activity support agency shall, in accordance with Article 22, Paragraph 4 of the Act , preserve the data set forth in each of the following subparagraphs for five years from the date the records are completed. <Amended July 1, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 1. 법 제22조제3항에 따른 활동지원급여비용 명세서 복사본
rows.text_en: 1. Copy of the statement of activity support benefit expenses pursuant to Article 22, Paragraph 3 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 방문간호지시서
rows.text_en: 2. Visiting Nurse Order

rows.source_ko: 3. 제13조제5항에 따른 계약서
rows.text_en: 3. Contract pursuant to Article 13 , Paragraph 5

rows.source_ko: 4. 제24조에 따른 활동지원급여 제공기록지
rows.text_en: 4. Activity support benefit provision record pursuant to Article 24

rows.source_ko: 제25조의2(활동지원기관 운영의 재무ㆍ회계 기준) 활동지원기관은 법 제22조제6항에 따라 그 운영에 관하여 「사회복지법인 및 사회복지시설 재무회계규칙」에 따라야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 25-2 (Financial and Accounting Standards for the Operation of Activity Support Agencies) In accordance with Article 22, Paragraph 6 of the Act , activity support agenciesshall comply with the “Financial Accounting Rules for Social Welfare Corporations and Social Welfare Facilities” regarding their operation
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 30, 2016]

rows.source_ko: 제25조의3(운영위원회의 설치 및 운영) ① 법 제22조의2제1항 단서에서 “보건복지부령으로 정하는 경우”란 다음 각 호의 요건을 모두 갖춘 경우를 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 25-3 (Establishment and Operation of the Steering Committee) ① The phrase “cases prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Health and Welfare” in the proviso to Article 22-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act refers to cases where all of the requirements of each of the following subparagraphs are met.

rows.source_ko: 1. 3개 이내의 활동지원기관일 것
rows.text_en: 1. Must be no more than three activity support agencies

rows.source_ko: 2. 같은 특별자치시ㆍ특별자치도ㆍ시ㆍ군ㆍ구에 있을 것
rows.text_en: 2. Must be located in the same Special Self-Governing City, Special Self-Governing Province, City, County, or District

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제22조의2제1항에 따른 운영위원회의 위원은 5명 이상 10명 이하로 구성하며, 위원장은 활동지원기관의 장이 아닌 위원 중에서 호선한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Steering Committee under Article 22-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be composed of 5 to 10 members, and the Chairperson shall be elected from among the members who are not the head of the activity support agency.

rows.source_ko: ③ 위원의 임기는 2년으로 하며, 한 차례만 연임할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ③ The term of office for a member shall be two years, and they may be reappointed only once.

rows.source_ko: ④ 제1항부터 제3항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 운영위원회의 운영에 관하여 필요한 세부 사항은 보건복지부장관이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ④ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 3, the Minister of Health and Welfare shall determine the detailed matters necessary for the operation of the Steering Committee .
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 30, 2016]

rows.source_ko: 제26조(활동지원기관의 폐업ㆍ휴업 신고) 법 제23조제1항 전단에 따라 폐업ㆍ휴업 신고를 하려는 활동지원기관은 별지 제14호서식의 활동지원기관 폐업ㆍ휴업 신고서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 26 (Reporting of Closure or Suspension of Business by Activity Support Agencies) An activity support agency intending to report closure or suspension of business pursuant to the first part of Article 23, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit the Report on Closure or Suspension of Business of an Activity Support Agency (Form No. 14) to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head, attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 1. 폐업ㆍ휴업 의결서 1부(법인만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 1. One copy of the Resolution for Business Closure or Suspension (applicable only to corporations)

rows.source_ko: 2. 수급자에 대한 조치계획서 1부
rows.text_en: 2. One copy of the action plan for the beneficiary

rows.source_ko: 3. 활동지원기관 지정서(폐업의 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 3. Designation Certificate for Activity Support Agency (applicable only in case of business closure)

rows.source_ko: 제26조의2(활동지원급여 제공 자료의 이관 절차) ① 활동지원기관의 장은 법 제23조제3항 본문에 따라 제25조 각 호의 자료를 별지 제14호의2서식과 함께 폐업 또는 휴업 예정일까지 관할 특별자치시ㆍ특별자치도ㆍ시ㆍ군ㆍ구에 이관하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 26-2 (Procedure for Transfer of Data on Provision of Activity Support Benefits) ① The head of an activity support agency shall,in accordance with the main text of Article 23, Paragraph 3 of the Act , transfer the data in each subparagraph of Article 25, together with Form No. 14-2 of the Appendix, to the competent Special Self-Governing City, Special Self-Governing Province, City, County, or District by the scheduled date of closure or suspension of business.

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제23조제3항 단서에 따라 활동지원급여 제공 자료를 직접 보관하려는 활동지원기관의 장은 별지 제14호의2서식의 신청서를 휴업 예정일 전까지 관할 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② In accordance with the proviso to Article 23, Paragraph 3 of the Act , the head of an activity support agency who intends to keep records of activity support benefits directly shall submit an application form in Annex 14-2 to the competent mayor of a special self-governing city, governor of a special self-governing province, mayor, county head, or district head before the scheduled date of suspension of business.

rows.source_ko: ③ 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제1항에 따른 신청서 등을 접수한 경우에는 해당 활동지원기관의 장에게 접수증을 발급하여야 하고, 제2항에 따른 신청서를 접수한 경우에는 해당 신청서를 검토하여 직접 보관을 허가할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head shall issue a receipt to the head of the relevant activity support agency upon receipt of an application form, etc. under Paragraph 1, and upon receipt of an application form under Paragraph 2, may review the application form and authorize direct storage.
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 30, 2016]

rows.source_ko: 제27조(활동지원기관에 대한 행정처분의 기준 등) ① 법 제24조제1항에 따른 활동지원기관에 대한 행정처분의 기준은 별표 2와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 27 (Standards for Administrative Dispositions against Activity Support Agencies, etc.) ①The standards for administrative dispositions against activity support agencies pursuant to Article 24, Paragraph 1 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 2 .

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제24조제1항에 따라 업무정지 또는 지정취소를 받은 활동지원기관은 수급자에 대한 조치계획서를 특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② An activity support agency that has been suspended from business or had its designation revoked pursuant to Article 24, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit a plan of measures for the beneficiary to the Special Self-Governing Province Governor, Mayor, County Governor, or District Head.

rows.source_ko: 제27조의2(과징금 부과대장의 기록ㆍ관리) 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 법 제24조의2제1항 또는 제2항에 따른 과징금 부과를 한 경우에는 별지 제14호의3서식의 과징금 부과대장(전자매체를 이용하여 관리하는 경우를 포함한다)에 그 사실을 기록ㆍ관리하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 27-2 (Recording and Management of the Register of Imposing Surcharges) Whena Special Self-Governing City Mayor, Special Self-Governing Province Governor, Mayor, County Governor, or District Head has imposed a surcharge pursuant to Article 24-2, Paragraph 1 or 2 of the Act , they shall record and manage the fact in the register of imposing surcharges in Form No. 14-3 of the Appendix (including cases where it is managed using electronic media).
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 30, 2016]

rows.source_ko: 제28조(활동지원급여의 평가) ① 공단은 법 제25조제1항에 따라 활동지원기관이 제공하는 활동지원급여의 종류별로 다음 각 호의 사항을 평가하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 28 (Evaluation of Activity Support Benefits) ① The Corporationshall evaluate the following matters for each type of activity support benefit provided by an activity support agency in accordance with Article 25, Paragraph 1 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: 1. 활동지원급여를 받는 수급자의 만족도
rows.text_en: 1. Satisfaction of recipients receiving activity support benefits

rows.source_ko: 2. 활동지원기관의 활동지원급여 제공 과정, 절차 및 내용
rows.text_en: 2. Process, Procedure, and Content of Activity Support Benefit Provision by Activity Support Agencies

rows.source_ko: 3. 활동지원기관의 운영 실태, 인력의 전문성 및 시설 환경
rows.text_en: 3. Operational status of activity support agencies, personnel expertise, and facility environment

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 활동지원기관의 운영 개선에 필요한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Other matters necessary for the improvement of the operation of activity support agencies

rows.source_ko: ② 공단은 제1항에 따라 평가한 결과를 공단의 홈페이지 등을 통하여 공개하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Corporation shall disclose the results of the evaluation conducted pursuant to Paragraph 1 through the Corporation’s website, etc.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항에 따른 평가의 방법, 시기 등 평가에 필요한 사항은 보건복지부장관이 정하여 고시한다.
rows.text_en: ③ Matters necessary for evaluation, such as the method and timing of evaluation pursuant to Paragraph 1, shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Health and Welfare .

rows.source_ko: 제29조(활동지원사의 교육과정) 법 제27조제1항에 따른 활동지원사(이하 “활동지원사”라 한다)의 교육과정은 별표 3과 같다. <개정 2018. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 29 (Educational Curriculum for Activity Support Workers) The educational curriculum for activity support workers (hereinafter referred to as “activity support workers”) pursuant to Article 27, Paragraph 1 of the Act is as set forth in Attached Table 3. <Amended Dec. 31, 2018>
[Title amended Dec. 31, 2018]

rows.source_ko: 제30조(활동지원사교육기관의 지정기준) 법 제28조제1항에서 “보건복지부령으로 정하는 지정기준”이란 별표 4의 기준을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 30 (Designation Standards for Activity Support Worker Training Institutions) In Article 28, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the term “designation standards prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Health and Welfare”refers to the standards in Annex 4 .
[Title amended Dec. 31, 2018]

rows.source_ko: 제31조(활동지원사교육기관의 지정 및 폐업ㆍ휴업 절차) ① 법 제28조제1항에 따라 활동지원사교육기관(이하 “교육기관”이라 한다)으로 지정받으려는 자는 별지 제15호서식의 활동지원사교육기관 지정신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 특별시장ㆍ광역시장ㆍ특별자치시장ㆍ도지사ㆍ특별자치도지사(이하 “시ㆍ도지사”라 한다)에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30., 2018. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 31 (Designation of Activity Support Worker Training Institutions and Procedures for Closure or Suspension of Business) ①Any person who intends to be designated as an Activity Support Worker Training Institution (hereinafter referred to as the “Training Institution”) pursuant to Article 28, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit an application for designation as an Activity Support Worker Training Institution in the form of Annex No. 15 , attaching the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Mayor of a Special City, Metropolitan City, Special Self-Governing City, Governor of a Province, or Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province (hereinafter referred to as the “City/Provincial Governor”). <Amended Dec. 30, 2016; Dec. 31, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 1. 정관 1부(법인만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 1. One copy of the Articles of Incorporation (applicable only to corporations)

rows.source_ko: 2. 교육계획서 및 교과과정표 각 1부
rows.text_en: 2. One copy each of the lesson plan and curriculum table

rows.source_ko: 3. 제30조에 따른 지정기준을 충족하였음을 확인할 수 있는 서류 1부
rows.text_en: 3. One copy of documents confirming that the designation criteria under Article 30 have been met

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 담당 공무원은 신청인이 법인인 경우 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서를 확인하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The public official in charge who receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall verify the certificate of corporate registration through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act if the applicant is a corporation.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 시ㆍ도지사는 법 제28조제1항에 따라 교육기관을 지정하는 경우에는 별지 제16호서식의 활동지원사교육기관 지정서를 발급해야 하며, 지정을 거부하는 경우에는 그 사유를 분명히 밝혀 신청인에게 서면으로 알려야 한다. <개정 2018. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ③ Upon receiving an application under Paragraph 1, the Mayor or Provincial Governor shall , when designating an educational institution pursuant to Article 28, Paragraph 1 of the Act , issue a Certificate of Designation as an Activity Support Worker Training Institution in the form of Annex 16 ; however, if the designation is refused, the Governor shall clearly state the reasons and notify the applicant in writing. <Amended Dec. 31, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ④ 교육기관 지정의 기준 및 방법 등에 관하여 필요한 세부 사항은 보건복지부장관이 정하여 고시한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Minister of Health and Welfare shall determine and announce the necessary detailed matters regarding the standards and methods for designating educational institutions .

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 법 제28조제1항에 따라 지정받은 교육기관은 지정받은 사항을 변경한 경우에는 변경사항이 발생한 날부터 14일 이내에 별지 제17호서식의 활동지원사교육기관 변경사항 통보서에 변경사항을 확인할 수 있는 서류 1부를 첨부하여 시ㆍ도지사에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2018. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ If an educational institution designated pursuant to Article 28, Paragraph 1 of the Act changes the designated matters, it shall submit a Notification of Changes to Activity Support Worker Educational Institutions ( Form No. 17) to the Mayor or Provincial Governor within 14 days from the date the change occurred, attaching one copy of documents verifying the change. <Amended Dec. 31, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 법 제28조제1항에 따라 지정받은 교육기관은 폐업하거나 휴업하려는 경우에는 폐업ㆍ휴업 예정일 30일 전까지 별지 제18호서식의 활동지원사교육기관 폐업ㆍ휴업 통보서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 시ㆍ도지사에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2018. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ If an educational institution designated pursuant to Article 28, Paragraph 1 of the Act intends to close or suspend operations , it shall submit the Notification of Closure or Suspension of Operation of Activity Support Worker Educational Institution ( Form No. 18) to the Mayor or Provincial Governor, attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs, at least 30 days prior to the scheduled date of closure or suspension. <Amended Dec. 31, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 1. 폐업ㆍ휴업 의결서 1부(법인만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 1. One copy of the Resolution for Business Closure or Suspension (applicable only to corporations)

rows.source_ko: 2. 교육생에 대한 조치계획서 1부
rows.text_en: 2. One copy of the action plan for the trainee

rows.source_ko: 3. 활동지원사교육기관 지정서(폐업의 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 3. Certificate of Designation as an Activity Support Worker Training Institution (applicable only in case of business closure)
[Title amended Dec. 30, 2016; Dec. 31, 2018]

rows.source_ko: 제32조(교육기관에 대한 행정처분의 기준) ① 법 제28조제2항에 따른 교육기관에 대한 행정처분의 기준은 별표 5와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 32 (Standards for Administrative Dispositions against Educational Institutions) ①The standards for administrative dispositions against educational institutions pursuant to Article 28, Paragraph 2 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 5 .

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제28조제2항에 따라 업무정지 또는 지정취소를 받은 교육기관은 교육 중인 교육생에 대한 조치계획서를 시ㆍ도지사에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② An educational institution that has received a suspension of business or cancellation of designation pursuant to Article 28, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall submit a plan of measures regarding trainees currently undergoing education to the mayor or provincial governor.

rows.source_ko: 제32조의2(범죄경력조회 등) ① 「장애인활동 지원에 관한 법률 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제20조의2제1항에 따른 범죄경력조회 요청서는 별지 제18호의2서식에 따른다. <개정 2018. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 32-2 (Criminal Background Check, etc.) ①The request form for a criminal background check pursuant to Article 20-2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Support for Activities of Persons with Disabilities (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall be in accordance with Form No. 18-2 of the Attached Form . <Amended Dec. 31, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제20조의2제2항에 따른 범죄경력조회 동의서는 별지 제18호의3서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The consent form for a criminal record check pursuant to Article 20-2, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 18-3 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제20조의2제3항에 따른 범죄경력조회 회신서는 별지 제18호의4서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ③ The reply to the criminal record inquiry pursuant to Article 20-2, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 18-4 of the Attached Form .
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 30, 2016]

rows.source_ko: 제32조의3(활동지원인력의 자격정지 기준) 법 제30조제2항에 따른 활동지원인력의 자격정지 기준은 별표 5의2와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 32-3 (Criteria for Suspension of Qualification of Activity Support Personnel) The criteria for suspension of qualification of activity support personnel pursuant to Article 30, Paragraph 2 of the Act are as set forth in Table 5-2 .
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 30, 2016]

rows.source_ko: 제33조(활동지원급여 수행이 제한되는 가족) 법 제30조제3항 본문에서 “보건복지부령으로 정하는 본인의 가족”이란 다음 각 호의 사람을 말한다. <개정 2016. 6. 30., 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 33 (Family Members Restricted from Performing Activity Support Benefits) In the main text of Article 30, Paragraph 3 of the Act , the term “family members of the person prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Health and Welfare” refers to any person falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended June 30, 2016; December 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 1. 배우자, 직계 혈족 및 형제ㆍ자매
rows.text_en: 1. Spouse, lineal blood relatives, and siblings

rows.source_ko: 2. 직계 혈족의 배우자
rows.text_en: 2. Spouse of a lineal blood relative

rows.source_ko: 3. 배우자의 직계 혈족 및 형제ㆍ자매
rows.text_en: 3. Spouse's lineal relatives and siblings

rows.source_ko: 제34조(활동지원급여비용의 청구 및 지급) ① 법 제31조제1항에 따라 활동지원급여비용(이하 “급여비용”이라 한다)을 청구하려는 활동지원기관은 활동지원급여 제공 즉시 보건복지부장관이 지정한 전자적 매체와 단말기를 통하여 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 청구하여야 한다. 다만, 전자적 매체와 단말기를 통하여 청구하는 것이 불가능한 경우에는 그 내용을 확인할 수 있는 서류를 첨부하여 서면으로 청구할 수 있다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 34 (Claim and Payment of Activity Support Benefit Costs) ① Any activity support agency intending to claim activity support benefit costs (hereinafter referred to as “benefit costs”) pursuant to Article 31, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall make a claim to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head immediately upon providing the activity support benefits, through electronic media and terminals designated by the Minister of Health and Welfare. However, if it is impossible to make a claim through electronic media and terminals, a claim may be made in writing by attaching documents that can verify the contents thereof. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: ② 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제1항에 따른 청구를 받은 경우에는 그 내용을 확인하고 지체 없이 급여비용을 활동지원기관에 지급하여야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② Upon receiving a claim pursuant to Paragraph 1, the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head shall verify the contents thereof and pay the benefit expenses to the activity support agency without delay. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: ③ 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제2항에 따라 지급된 급여비용이 잘못 산정되었거나 과부족(過不足)이 있는 경우에는 해당 금액을 활동지원기관으로부터 돌려받거나 추가로 지급하여야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ③ If the benefit expenses paid pursuant to Paragraph 2 have been calculated incorrectly or involve an overpayment or underpayment, the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head shall recover the relevant amount from the activity support agency or pay it additionally. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: ④ 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 법 제31조제3항에 따라 급여비용의 지급에 관한 업무를 위탁하는 경우에는 급여비용 지급에 필요할 것으로 예상되는 금액을 미리 영 제22조에 따른 수탁기관에 예탁(預託)하여야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ④ When a Special Self-Governing City Mayor, Special Self-Governing Province Governor, Mayor, County Head, or District Head entrusts duties concerning the payment of benefit expenses pursuant to Article 31, Paragraph 3 of the Act , they shall deposit in advance the amount expected to be necessary for the payment of benefit expenses with the entrusted institution pursuant to Article 22 of the Enforcement Decree . <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 제1항부터 제4항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 급여비용의 청구, 지급, 예탁 등에 필요한 사항은 보건복지부장관이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 4, matters necessary for the claim, payment, deposit, etc. of benefit expenses shall be determined by the Minister of Health and Welfare .

rows.source_ko: 제35조(급여비용 지급 등의 업무의 위탁) 법 제31조제3항에 따라 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 다음 각 호의 업무를 영 제22조에 따른 수탁기관에 위탁한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 35 (Entrustment of Duties Regarding Payment of Salary Expenses, etc.) Pursuant to Article 31, Paragraph 3 of the Act , the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head shall entrust the duties set forth in each of the following subparagraphs to an entrusted institution pursuant to Article 22 of the Enforcement Decree . <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 1. 법 제17조제2항에 따른 활동지원급여이용권의 지급
rows.text_en: 1. Payment of activity support benefit vouchers pursuant to Article 17 , Paragraph 2 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 법 제31조제1항 및 제2항에 따른 급여비용의 지급과 정산
rows.text_en: 2. Payment and settlement of salary expenses pursuant to Article 31, Paragraphs 1 and 2 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 법 제33조에 따른 본인부담금의 수납과 정산
rows.text_en: 3. Collection and settlement of co-payments pursuant to Article 33 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 4. 법 제34조에 따른 방문간호지시서 발급비용의 지급과 정산
rows.text_en: 4. Payment and settlement of fees for issuing visiting nurse orders pursuant to Article 34 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 5. 법 제35조에 따른 부당지급급여에 관한 조사
rows.text_en: 5. Investigation into improperly paid benefits pursuant to Article 35 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 6. 법 제40조에 따른 장애인활동지원정보시스템의 구축 및 운영(제1호부터 제5호까지 및 제7호의 업무와 관련된 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 6. Establishment and operation of the Information System for Activity Support for Persons with Disabilities pursuant to Article 40 of the Act (only applicable in cases related to the duties under Subparagraphs 1 through 5 and Subparagraph 7)

rows.source_ko: 7. 영 제27조에 따른 긴급활동지원 비용의 지급과 정산
rows.text_en: 7. Payment and settlement of emergency activity support expenses pursuant to Article 27 of the Enforcement Decree

rows.source_ko: 제36조(급여비용의 산정 방법) ① 법 제32조에 따라 급여비용은 활동지원급여의 종류별로 다음 각 호의 방법에 따라 산정한다.
rows.text_en: Article 36 (Method of Calculating Benefit Costs) ① Pursuant to Article 32 of the Act , benefit costs shall be calculated according to the methods in each of the following subparagraphs for each type of activity support benefit.

rows.source_ko: 1. 법 제16조제1항제1호에 따른 활동보조: 급여 제공 시간 × 시간당 비용
rows.text_en: 1. Activity assistance pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the Act : Hours of service provision × Hourly cost

rows.source_ko: 2. 법 제16조제1항제2호에 따른 방문목욕: 급여 제공을 위한 방문 횟수 × 횟수당 비용
rows.text_en: 2. Visiting bathing pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Act : Number of visits for service provision × Cost per visit

rows.source_ko: 3. 법 제16조제1항제3호에 따른 방문간호: 급여 제공 시간 × 시간당 비용
rows.text_en: 3. Visiting nursing pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3 of the Act : Hours provided × Hourly cost

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에서 규정한 사항 외에 급여비용의 산정에 필요한 사항은 보건복지부장관이 정하여 고시한다.
rows.text_en: ② In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraph 1, matters necessary for the calculation of benefit costs shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Health and Welfare .

rows.source_ko: 제37조(본인부담금의 산정 방법) 법 제33조제1항 및 제3항에 따른 본인부담금의 산정 방법은 별표 6과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 37 (Method of Calculating Co-payment) The method of calculating the co-payment pursuant to Article 33, Paragraphs 1 and 3 of the Act is as set forth in Attached Table 6 .

rows.source_ko: 제38조(정액 본인부담금을 부담하는 경우) 법 제33조제3항제4호에서 “보건복지부령으로 정하는 사유”란 천재지변, 화재 또는 이에 준하는 사유로 피해를 입은 지역으로서 보건복지부장관이 정하여 고시하는 지역에 거주하고 피해 정도가 일정 기준에 이르는 경우를 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 38 (Cases where a fixed co-payment is borne) In Article 33, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 4 of the Act , “reasons prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Health and Welfare” refers to cases where a person resides in an area that has suffered damage due to natural disasters, fires, or causes equivalent thereto, and which is designated and notified by the Minister of Health and Welfare , and the degree of damage reaches a certain standard.

rows.source_ko: 제39조(본인부담금의 유효기간) 법 제33조제5항에 따라 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 매년 정기적으로 모든 수급자를 대상으로 다음 각 호의 사항을 조사하여 본인부담금을 새로 산정해야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30., 2018. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 39 (Validity Period of Co-payment) Pursuant to Article 33, Paragraph 5 of the Act , the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head shall annually conduct a periodic investigation of the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs for all beneficiaries and recalculate the co-payment. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016; Dec. 31, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 1. 신청인, 배우자 및 부양의무자의 「국민건강보험법」 제69조에 따른 월별 보험료액
rows.text_en: 1. Monthly insurance premium amount under Article 69 of the National Health Insurance Act for the applicant, spouse, and persons with support obligations

rows.source_ko: 2. 신청인이 법 제33조제3항 또는 제4항에 해당하는지 여부
rows.text_en: 2. Whether the applicant falls under Article 33 , Paragraph 3 or 4 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 제40조(본인부담금의 변경) ① 법 제33조제5항에 따라 본인부담금을 변경하려는 수급자는 별지 제19호서식의 본인부담금 변경신청서에 변경사항을 확인할 수 있는 서류 1부를 첨부하여 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 40 (Change of Co-payment) ①A beneficiary who intends to change the co-payment pursuant to Article 33, Paragraph 5 of the Act shall submit an Application for Change of Co-payment in the form of Annex No. 19 , attached with one copy of documents verifying the changes, to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 변경사항을 확인하고 변경 여부를 결정하여야 하며, 결정한 경우에는 지체 없이 그 내용과 사유를 수급자에게 서면으로 알려야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Governor, or a District Head who receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall verify the matters to be changed and decide whether to approve the change; if such decision is made, they shall notify the beneficiary in writing of the details and reasons thereof without delay. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제2항에 따라 본인부담금이 변경 결정된 경우 변경된 본인부담금은 결정된 날이 속한 달의 다음 달부터 적용한다.
rows.text_en: ③ If the co-payment amount is changed pursuant to Paragraph 2, the changed co-payment amount shall apply from the month following the month in which the decision was made.

rows.source_ko: 제41조(본인부담금의 납부 및 환급) ① 법 제33조제5항에 따라 수급자는 활동지원급여를 받으려면 매달 본인부담금을 법 제11조제1항에 따른 활동지원수급자격결정통지서에 기재된 계좌로 미리 납부하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 41 (Payment and Refund of Co-payments) ① In accordance with Article 33, Paragraph 5 of the Act , in order to receive activity support benefits, a recipientmust pay a monthly co-payment in advance to the account specified in the notice of determination of eligibility for activity support benefits pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 1 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: ② 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제1항에 따라 납부된 본인부담금 중 수급자가 활동지원급여를 받지 않아 활동지원기관에 지급되지 않은 본인부담금을 정산하여 수급자에게 환급하여야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head shall settle the co-payments paid pursuant to Paragraph 1 that have not been paid to the activity support agency because the recipient has not received activity support benefits, and refund them to the recipient. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 및 제2항에서 규정한 사항 외에 본인부담금의 납부, 환급 등에 필요한 사항은 보건복지부장관이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ③ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 and 2, matters necessary for the payment, refund, etc. of co-payments shall be determined by the Minister of Health and Welfare .

rows.source_ko: 제42조(방문간호지시서 발급비용의 부담 등) ① 법 제34조제1항 본문에 따라 수급자는 방문간호지시서의 발급비용을 법 제18조에 따른 활동지원급여의 월 한도액을 사용하여 부담할 수 있고, 월 한도액을 초과하는 비용은 본인이 전액 부담한다.
rows.text_en: Article 42 (Burden of Costs for Issuing Visiting Nursing Orders, etc.) ①Pursuant to the main text of Article 34, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the beneficiary may bear the cost of issuing visiting nursing orders by using the monthly limit of activity support benefits under Article 18 of the Act , and any costs exceeding the monthly limit shall be borne in full by the beneficiary.

rows.source_ko: ② 방문간호지시서 발급비용의 산정기준은 의료기관의 종류 및 수급자 방문 여부 등을 고려하여 보건복지부장관이 정하여 고시한다.
rows.text_en: ② The criteria for calculating the cost of issuing a visiting nurse order shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Health and Welfare, taking into consideration the type of medical institution and whether the beneficiary is visited .

rows.source_ko: ③ 방문간호지시서 발급비용의 청구 및 지급에 필요한 사항은 급여비용의 청구 및 지급에 관한 사항에 준하여 보건복지부장관이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ③ Matters necessary for the billing and payment of the cost of issuing a visiting nurse order shall be determined by the Minister of Health and Welfare in accordance with matters concerning the billing and payment of benefit costs .

rows.source_ko: 제43조(긴급활동지원의 신청 등) ① 영 제27조에 따른 긴급활동지원을 받으려는 사람은 긴급활동지원 신청서에 신청 사유를 확인할 수 있는 서류 1부를 첨부하여 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 43 (Application for Emergency Activity Support, etc.) ① Any person who wishes to receive emergency activity support pursuant to Article 27 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit an application for emergency activity support, attached with one copy of documents verifying the grounds for the application, to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 영 제27조에 따라 긴급활동지원 제공을 결정하는 경우에는 지체 없이 긴급활동지원수급자격결정통지서를 발급하여야 하며, 제공을 거부하는 경우에는 그 사유를 분명히 밝혀 신청인에게 서면으로 알려야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② Upon receiving an application under Paragraph 1, the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head shall, if they decide to provide emergency activity support pursuant to Article 27 of the Enforcement Decree , issue a Notice of Determination of Eligibility for Emergency Activity Support without delay; however, if they refuse to provide such support, they shall clearly state the reasons and notify the applicant in writing. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제27조에 따라 긴급활동지원을 받는 사람은 지원 비용을 본인이 부담하지 아니한다.
rows.text_en: ③ Persons receiving emergency activity support pursuant to Article 27 of the Enforcement Decree shall not bear the costs of the support themselves.

rows.source_ko: ④ 제1항부터 제3항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 긴급활동지원에 필요한 세부 사항은 해당 지방자치단체의 장이 정한다. <개정 2025. 3. 25.>
rows.text_en: ④ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 through 3, detailed matters necessary for emergency activity support shall be determined by the head of the relevant local government. <Amended Mar. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제44조(이의신청) ① 법 제36조제1항에 따라 이의신청을 하려는 사람은 이의신청서에 주장하는 사실을 확인할 수 있는 서류 1부를 첨부하여 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 44 (Objection) ① Any person who intends to file an objection pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit an objection form, attached with one copy of documents verifying the asserted facts, to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 지체 없이 신청 서류의 사본을 이해관계인에게 보내야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Governor, or a District Head who receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall send a copy of the application documents to the interested parties without delay. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>
